# Tilburg University Research Portal

> Institutional research repository and publications database showcasing Tilburg University's academic research across multiple schools and disciplines.

The Tilburg University Research Portal serves as the central hub for discovering research, researcher profiles, and publications across the university's five academic schools. It provides access to institutional research outputs aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals and supports research collaboration and discovery.

## Key Topics

- Tilburg University
- Research Portal
- Institutional Repository
- Publications Database
- Researcher Profiles

## Portal Home & Overview

- [Tilburg University Research Portal](https://research.tilburguniversity.edu): Main entry point for the institutional research repository and publications database
- [Tilburg University Research Portal Home](https://research.tilburguniversity.edu/en/home): Home page featuring researcher profiles and research publications across the university
- [Tilburg University Research Portal Index](https://research.tilburguniversity.edu/en/home/index): Index page providing navigation to academic departments and research organizations

## Academic Schools & Organizations

- [Tilburg University](https://research.tilburguniversity.edu/en/organisations/tilburg-university): Tilburg University organizational profile with research areas and faculty directory
- [TS Economics and Management](https://research.tilburguniversity.edu/en/organisations/ts-economics-and-management): School of Economics and Management research organization with econometrics and finance research
- [TS Social and Behavioral Sciences](https://research.tilburguniversity.edu/en/organisations/ts-social-and-behavioral-sciences): School of Social and Behavioral Sciences research organization with health research focus
- [TS of Humanities and Digital Sciences](https://research.tilburguniversity.edu/en/organisations/ts-of-humanities-and-dig-sciences): School of Humanities and Digital Sciences featuring cognitive science and artificial intelligence research
- [Tilburg Law School](https://research.tilburguniversity.edu/en/organisations/tilburg-law-school): Law School research organization profile focusing on legal studies and research
- [Tilburg School of Catholic Theology](https://research.tilburguniversity.edu/en/organisations/tilburg-school-of-catholic-theology): School of Catholic Theology research organization profile and academic activities
